text:
deploybot: Canary for rc-2026-03 started -> vuln-scan flagged. Status: HOLD. One transitive 'moderate' CVE in libxml2, no SBOM provenance for that package. Tag: image:ghcr.io/redwood/worker:20260315-rc
emma-eng: pinging security & qa. can we get quick triage? what are rollback/pin options? :eyes:
raj-security: I see the scan. It's transitive via a tooling dep. Need to verify exploitability (CVE-2022-xxxx). If exploitability low and no runtime exposure, we can consider timeboxed hold + mitigation. Otherwise roll back.
chris-qa: Canary tests are green on functional suite. No crashes. Observability shows slightly elevated 500s at t+2m but back to baseline. Might be noise.
linh-release: If we pin, we can revert the image to digest from yesterday (digest: sha256:abcd1234). That would unblock canary quickly but we lose the rc-2026-03 change. We should record in release notes.
maria-prodops: What about scoped rollback? Keep canary limited to 5% or EU-only while triaging? Change window ends in ~4h.
raj-security: Options summary:
- rollback to previous digest (fast, safe)
- pin this transitive package in build (slower, needs patch)
- timebox hold 90m for security to rule out exploitability, then decide
- scoped carveout (limited canary) if policy allows
emma-eng: I'm leaning toward 90m triage window. If we can't produce proof of non-exploitability or a quick patch, fallback to previous digest. Maria, can ops implement a scoped 5% continue? If not, we'll plan rollback.
maria-prodops: I can limit to 5% for the next 60m. I'll schedule an automated rollback at +90m if we don't update thread.
raj-security: I'll start exploitability assessment and ask infra for SBOM evidence. If we confirm the dependency is only in build-time toolchain and not shipped, we can approve continuation. ETA 45m.
chris-qa: I'll run the security-e2e quick checks and try to reproduce any exploit surface. Reporting back in 40m.
deploybot: Scan output snippet: ```
VULN: libxml2 CVE-2022-xxxx
Severity: Moderate
Path: /workspace/tools/parser -> libxml2:2.9.12
Provenance: MISSING
``` Link: https://deploybot.internal/scans/1725001234
emma-eng: OK plan agreed: 60m limited canary (5%), 90m hard timebox for triage. If no clearance, rollback to sha256:abcd1234. Everyone post updates here. I'll add a release-note blurb draft so comms are ready.
linh-release: Draft for release-notes: "Deployment delayed for rc-2026-03 canary due to a transitive vulnerability flagged by scan; rolling back canary if unresolved. No user-facing impact expected." Will post PR.
raj-security: Update: infra found SBOM entry for libxml2 in build container only. Still verifying whether it's included in runtime image. If confirmed build-only, we can mark as false-positive for rollout. Will update in ~25m.
chris-qa: Quick E2E run finished, no exploitable surface. +1 tentative. Waiting for SBOM confirmation.
maria-prodops: Scoped 5% canary in effect. Automatic rollback scheduled at 90m from now unless thread updated with "clear to proceed".
emma-eng: Thanks team. If anyone finds a blocking repro, call rollback immediately. :hand:
-- end --
